factionapi.configuration.title: FactionApi Configuration
factionapi.configuration.renderTotemFact: When enabled, renders the owning faction's name above totem blocks.
factionapi.configuration.addFactionMenuB: When enabled, adds a shortcut button to the faction menu in the player inventory screen.
factionapi.configuration.factionMenuButt: Horizontal offset of the faction menu button from the center of the screen, in pixels.
Vertical offset of the faction menu button from the center of the screen, in pixels.
factionapi.configuration.showFactionLeve: When enabled, renders the faction level indicator in the HUD.
factionapi.configuration.factionLevelOve: Horizontal offset of the faction level indicator from the center of the screen, in pixels.
Vertical offset of the faction level indicator from the bottom of the screen, in pixels.
factionapi.configuration.showFactionRaid: When enabled, renders the faction raid bar overlay in the HUD.
factionapi.configuration.showActionCoold: When enabled, renders the action cooldown indicator in the HUD.
factionapi.configuration.showActionDurat: When enabled, renders the action duration indicator in the HUD.
factionapi.configuration.villageMaxSpawn: Maximum number of villagers the totem can respawn.
factionapi.configuration.villageAllowPoi: When enabled, allows players to destroy point of interest blocks in faction villages they do not own.
factionapi.configuration.villageMaximumT: Maximum range of a totem used to grow the village.
factionapi.configuration.raidRandomChanc: Chance per second of a faction raid occurring.
factionapi.configuration.raidPhaseOneDur: Duration of phase one of the capturing process, in seconds.
factionapi.configuration.raidPhaseTwoMem: Raid Phase Two Members Force Target Time
Time in seconds during capture phase two after which capture entities seek a target regardless of distance.
factionapi.configuration.raidNotifyDista: Squared distance within which players are notified of a village capture.
factionapi.configuration.raidDisableVill: When enabled, prevents villagers in controlled villages from turning into guard villagers when attacked.
factionapi.configuration.factionColorInC: When enabled, colors player names in chat based on their current faction.
factionapi.configuration.factionLordPref: When enabled, adds a title prefix based on the current lord level to player names in chat.
factionapi.configuration.factionPvpOnlyB: When enabled, PVP is only allowed between members of different factions. Requires PVP to be enabled in server properties. Not guaranteed to always protect teammates.
factionapi.configuration.factionUnlockAl: When enabled, allows unlocking all skills upon reaching max level.
factionapi.configuration.factionSkillPoi: Number of skill points awarded per level-up. Values other than 2 are unbalanced. To unlock all skills at max level, set to skill-amount
Number of skill points awarded per lord level-up. Values other than 2 are unbalanced. To unlock all skills at max lord level, set to skill-amount
factionapi.configuration.minionDeathReco: Time in seconds a minion needs to recover after death.
factionapi.configuration.minionPerLordLe: Number of minions a player may have per lord level.
factionapi.configuration.minionOfflineRe: Cooldown multiplier for collect resource task types while the owning player is offline.
factionapi.configuration.minionEquipment: Amount by which minion equipment is repaired when completing resource tasks.
factionapi.configuration.taskDurationSin: Duration in minutes within which a task must be completed in a singleplayer world.
factionapi.configuration.taskDurationDed: Duration in minutes within which a task must be completed on a dedicated server.
factionapi.configuration.taskMasterMaxTa: Maximum number of tasks shown at a taskmaster, excluding unique tasks.
factionapi.configuration.entitiesIMob.to: Controls whether faction entities are recognized as hostile by other mods. See https://github.com/TeamLapen/Vampirism/issues/199. Smart falls back to Never on servers.
factionapi.configuration.preventDebugBou: When enabled, prevents players from enabling debug bounding box rendering, which can reveal disguised entities.
When enabled, uses the Forge permission system for certain actions. See the wiki for more information.
factionapi.configuration.enableFactionLo: When enabled, writes a custom log file for specific faction actions. Only applies to dedicated servers. Requires a server restart.
